attackers_goals: Modify the S3 configuration and expose stored sensitive data.
description: An S3 bucket configuration has been deleted. This may affect the S3 access, and the objects it contains.
detector_tags: Cloud Data Asset Disaster Recovery Risks, Cloud Data Asset Stealth Tactics, Cloud Data Asset Configuration, Data Detection & Response
investigative_actions: Check what data is stored on the S3. Check which configuration change has been made. Verify this change did not make this S3 publicly available.
name: S3 configuration deletion
